robots.name: Bouncing Ball
robots.description: Interactive 3D physics simulation with Rapier.js — drop balls, change gravity (Earth/Moon/Mars/Jupiter/Zero-G), orbit camera

robots.name: Robot Arm
robots.description: 3-DOF robot arm simulator — control joints with sliders, watch forward kinematics, run pick-and-place demo

robots.description: Robot navigates random mazes using Wall Following, A*, or BFS — compare algorithms side by side

robots.name: Line Follower

robots.name: Object Detector
robots.description: Real-time object detection in your browser — DETR model identifies 80 objects from webcam via Transformers.js

robots.name: DC Motor Controller
robots.description: PID-controlled DC motor driver for Arduino — speed control, direction, encoder feedback with wiring guide
